title: Eastern-Style Lamb Kibbeh
description: A flavorful and exotic Middle Eastern dish made with lamb and kibbeh, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe features a delicate balance of spices and a crispy exterior.

ingredients.name: Middle eastern spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the ground lamb and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the kibbeh, Middle Eastern spices, and salt. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and shape into a flat layer.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
